newsitem.title: USA: Ibis Technology to redeem warrants.
newsitem.headline: Ibis Technology to redeem warrants.

text.p: Ibis Technology, a maker of silicon wafers for the semiconductor industry, said Thursday that it will redeem all of the company's outstanding publically traded common stock purchase warrents.

Under the redemption plan, the company said in statement, each warrant holder will be paid the redemption price of $0.20 per warrant. The closing date for the transaction is 1700 EDT /2200 GMT on Aug 25. Redemption will occur on Aug 26.

The company said all warrants have to be surrendered to Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Co. It added that anyone not taking part in the redemption plan will only be entitled to the redemption price and will have forfeited their right to use the warrants to redeem shares in the company.
A warrant entitles the holder to buy or sell a stock at a given price and time.
